items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: Luckily I was not playing a melodic instrument, but I was with him almost four years

ctx.x: Different feel. Different cadences. Different tempos. Different keys. Luckily I was not playing a melodic instrument, but I was with him almost four years and some songs, especially the familiar ones, “Like a Rolling Stone,” “It’s All Over Now,” “Baby Blue,” “Tangled Up in Blue,” “Maggie’s Farm,” “Subterranean Homesick Blues,” things that were more often than not on the set list, at some point in the set list, if Bob thought that we knew what he was going to do he would change it immediately. He didn’t want…
Well how did he make it known? Did he play something on the guitar to set it up?
